def __call__(self, *sequences: Sequence) -> float:
        result = self.quick_answer(*sequences)
        if result is not None:
            return result

        sequences = self._get_counters(*sequences)
        intersection = self._count_counters(*sequences)           # Changed method call
        intersection = self._intersect_counters(intersection)     # Swapped methods
        sequences = [self._count_counters(s) for s in sequences]

        return intersection / (sum(sequences) + 1)                # Changed min to sum, added +1
